summary: Backend developer working in software since 2017. I build Node.js and TypeScript services for APIs, integrations, transaction processing and asynchronous jobs. My experience includes PostgreSQL, Redis and RabbitMQ, defining API contracts across teams and owning service integrations. Additional experience includes React, developing and testing Rust programs for Solana, and leading a small frontend team.

experience.description: I develop and maintain a Node.js service that connects the product’s Ruby backend to Solana through an HTTP API. The backend prepares transactions, tracks their execution and confirmation, and records payment states and statuses in PostgreSQL using Prisma. I implement the preparation, validation and creation of Solana accounts, and work with the Ruby team on API contracts, retries and error handling. The service also supports compressed NFT minting and verification.

I worked on the Node.js backend for a token launch and streaming platform. My responsibilities included WebRTC functionality using Janus, integrations with Twitch and YouTube, and WebSocket communication with the client. I designed relational database schemas in PostgreSQL and worked with Prisma and Redis. I also developed a TypeScript SDK with a shared interface for Raydium, Pump.fun, Moonshot, Orca and Jupiter, built the token launch onboarding interface, and wrote Rust smart contracts for launches, liquidity locking, whitelists and migration to Raydium.

I developed and maintained a Node.js backend in a microservice architecture, integrating the product with Solana through wallet interactions, transaction processing and on-chain data synchronisation. I worked with MongoDB through Mongoose and with Redis. I also developed and tested the Rust programs behind these flows, implementing signature verification and replay protection for on-chain actions.

I worked on the Node.js backend for a React application, developing its GraphQL API and BFF integration with the main backend. My responsibilities also included the React client and tests for Solana programs.

I developed the backend for a crypto-swap portal, building APIs and integrations with external exchange services and smart contracts. I designed the relational database schema in PostgreSQL, used RabbitMQ for asynchronous jobs and Redis for caching, and wrote service tests with Jest.

I developed Node.js backend services for an NFT auction product in a microservice architecture. The work included relational data storage in PostgreSQL, caching with Redis, third-party integrations and realtime bidding updates over WebSocket and SSE.
I developed React and Vue interfaces, managed application state with Redux and integrated the frontend with backend APIs.

I developed single-page applications and began working on Node.js backend functionality. Later, I led a small frontend team, taking responsibility for planning, architecture decisions and code reviews.
I built website interfaces from designs, implementing layouts and interactive features with HTML, CSS and JavaScript.
